description: Returns the status of a Monatsreporting run (month-end close): its phase plus the number of open anomaly cases, open clarification questions and open follow_up checks (follow_ups_open). period (YYYY-MM) selects the active run of that month (not superseded or failed); without a run for it the answer says so. run_id takes precedence over period; with neither, the most recent run is returned. READ ONLY. A run is started with start-month-run; approving, publishing and closing happen only in the app.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

period.description: Optional month, YYYY-MM: the active run of that month.

run_id.description: Optional UUID of the run. Takes precedence over period.

name: get-month-run-status
